content: Construction progress on developer sites (2026: EffectLab Zoria2, Vikilinks, 247realestatemarketing, dignuzdesign): live progress dashboards and dated construction photo reports are rare differentiators that build trust; buyers watch visible progress over 12-18 months and forgive delays from honest updates; progress content should be dated and paired with renders, never standalone; 'last updated' timestamps essential; weekly email progress updates keep lists warm. Flivv's live Google Sheets/GViz dashboard with 20s SWR polling already exceeds industry norm (most publish static photo galleries); unify the 5 copy-pasted progress components into one configurable component while keeping Sheets as source.
